# Each subdirectory's CMakeLists.txt adds to the following variables, which are passed up
# to the parent scope:
#
# - share_lib_sources: all source files in the directory (other than genf90 templates),
#   for building the csm_share library
#
# - share_genf90_sources: Fortran files generated by genf90 from *.F90.in templates
#
# - share_sources: the subset of sources (including generated sources) that is used for
#   unit tests. Note that this is used by other components (e.g., CTSM) as well as by the
#   unit tests in this repository.

add_subdirectory(const)
add_subdirectory(util)
add_subdirectory(coupling)
add_subdirectory(science)

sourcelist_to_parent(share_lib_sources)
sourcelist_to_parent(share_genf90_sources)
sourcelist_to_parent(share_sources)
